name: Vinyl Reality - DJ in VR
summary:
Master the art of DJing in VR! Vinyl Reality is the most authentic and realistic simulation of DJing with vinyl available for VR. 

Import your own tracks and mix them on two faithfully recreated vinyl turntables and a fully-featured DJ mixer with accurate and intuitive controls. Record or stream your DJ sets from a selection of built-in stages with awesome audio reactive crowds, lights, screens and effects. Personalize your experience with free custom environments, avatars or background visuals.
